tweet.text:
Introducing Swarms v16 “OverClock” 🔋👾

This is our biggest and most powerful update yet. We shipped 114 commits across 228 files, bringing enhanced performance,reliability, and observability.

OverClock introduces DecisionModel for typed, calibrated decisions, MCPDeployer for serving agents as MCP servers, TreeOfThoughts for enhanced reasoning, and much more.

Learn more ⬇️🧵
